ucdp.role: civilianDeaths enrichment plus city-scoped aerial attack-day gap fill

method.weaponAttribution: direct city OR single oblast confirmed by exact-city VIINA; national/multi-region totals excluded
method.ucdpCasualtyEnrichment: exact UCDP city/date, where_prec=1, date_prec=1, Russia-Ukraine dyad, explicit aerial evidence; clean rows use refined UCDP deaths; mixed rows require city-specific aerial death evidence; audited manual overrides resolve known mixed cases; merge by MAX with existing deaths
method.ucdpAttackDayGapFill: UCDP-only exact city/date aerial events may create attack days; tactical drones included; city outskirts included; municipal districts explicitly inside the city included; region/oblast-only and administrative district/raion-only excluded; Kherson occupation-period and audited date-quality duplicates excluded
